node.statement: All scalar datum errors are at most t_2: epsilon_U <= W.L*epsilon <= t_2; d_U <= c0*epsilon_U <= c0*W.L*epsilon <= t_2; ||v_U(I)-u_{A_U}|| <= c0*epsilon_U <= t_2; epsilon_R=W.L*epsilon <= t_2; and the direct-envelope errors L^0*epsilon and c0*epsilon, as well as the supplied error ||w(I)-I_A|| <= c0*epsilon, are at most t_2. Here W.K2 >= max{1,W.L,c0*W.L} and W.L >= L^0 >= 1.
